nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Header-auth credential, NOT an IF node comparing a literal. The secret is then encrypted with N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY, never appears in a workflow export, and n8n rejects a bad token with 403 before any node runs.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: { subject: $json.subject, body: { contentType: 'Text', content: $json.body }, toRecipients: [ { emailAddress: { address: $json.to } } ], replyTo: $json.replyTo ? [ { emailAddress: { address: $json.replyTo } } ] : [] }, saveToSentItems: true }) }}

nodes.name: Send via Graph (noreply@)
nodes.notes: App-only Graph sendMail from the 'Macgear Portal Mailer' app registration, scoped by an Exchange application access policy to noreply@ ONLY (docs/email_delivery.md Part 1). App-only can send as a SHARED mailbox — no licence, cannot be signed into, and no person in the loop. The n8n Microsoft Outlook node cannot do this: it uses DELEGATED auth and always sends as the signed-in mailbox. The From display name comes from the MAILBOX ('Macgear Group'), not from this payload. Change the address in the URL to change the sender. replyTo is set to the inviting admin by the app.

nodes.name: Respond error
nodes.notes: The portal reads only the HTTP status — it logs a failure and keeps showing the copyable link. This body is for whoever is reading the Executions list.
